prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1487; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's all right. You have my claim information.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping center. I was in the right lane going about thirty-five miles an hour.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes to the left because I needed to turn at the next light. I checked my mirror and I didn't see anyone, so I started moving over.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?

A: I believe I did, yes. I had it on for a while before I moved.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other car came up in the left lane and sideswiped my front passenger side. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jerk toward the median. I got it stopped on the shoulder.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not until it was right there. It seemed to come out of my blind spot very quickly.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck started hurting almost right away, and by the next morning I had stiffness and pain going into my shoulders. I've been seeing a doctor about it and I'm doing physical therapy.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment at the scene?

A: No, I didn't feel it was serious at first. I went to urgent care the following day.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I was trying to drive safely and I think the other driver should have been watching for cars before they pulled over. That's about all I have.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
